priorIteration.note: 4 findings: FIND-101 (critical, colony-wallets.json repurposing risk -- claude-p's own human-funded wallet sat unclassified in the file REQ-105/305 planned to aggregate colony surplus from) resolved by abandoning the repurposing entirely -- REQ-105 now creates a brand-new, dedicated ~/anicca/skills/self/spawn/registry/citizens.json, seeded with a fixed literal 2-entry array (automaton + Franklin only), colony-wallets.json left completely untouched/out-of-scope, and REQ-305's append path now calls isSelfFunded() before every append and refuses if false (permanent closure, not just t=0). FIND-102 (major, REQ-206 EARS/edge-case self-contradiction over both-anchors-present) resolved by rewriting the EARS clause to state at-least-one/not-XOR explicitly, adding a 5th acceptance fixture and new PROP-206e. FIND-103 (major, withGigLock's mandatory statePath argument never specified, risking silent lock-identity drift across call sites) resolved by designating citizens.json's own path as the canonical statePath, exported as a single CITIZENS_REGISTRY_PATH constant from a new registry-path.mjs module, with new PROP-103d requiring a structural check that every call site imports this same constant. FIND-104 (medium, wallet.evm/solana typed as strings in the spec but implemented as booleans in is-self-funded.mjs) resolved by splitting the citizen record into two fields: wallet:{evm?:boolean,solana?:boolean} (exact match to isSelfFunded()'s real boolean contract) and walletAddress:{evm?:string,solana?:string} (the real address strings for REQ-305/other consumers, never passed to isSelfFunded()).
